values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov up to 3 days before arrival; 21 of the 31 catalog sites are first-come. Weekend stays need 2 nights, holiday weekends 3; no more than 16 nights in a rolling 30 days. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. Run by a concessionaire (American Land & Leisure).

values.note: Interagency Senior and Access passes give 50% off single campsites only (the site the pass holder occupies); enter the pass at booking.

note: Manistee NF campground, the only Forest Service campground on the Pine National Scenic River, on M-37 at the Pine River bridge 1.5 mi S of M-55 (21 mi N of Baldwin). Many RV sites are shaded and secluded; the riverbank tent sites can also be reached from the river. Canoe/boat launch across the river at Peterson Bridge North; a watercraft permit is required on the Pine from Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + RIDB catalog + FS page (updated 2026-06-26): $35 single (2026-2028, confirmed), no electric (confirmed), 30 public sites (17 RV, back-in, 38-64 ft; 13 tent-only) (new), flush toilets and potable water (new), derived vault toilets cleared (FS restrooms: flush only), season late April - mid October (new), reservable on rec.gov (confirmed) with 21 first-come catalog sites, 3-day cutoff, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum, 16 nights in 30 (all new), senior/access 50% (now stated). Water/sewer left as derived false (catalog silent). No Huron-Manistee alert or order affects M-37 or the campground (only the standing Pine River corridor order). Note trimmed of field restatements.
